item.title: [+3] Rupee streak trips on dollar demand, falls 35 paise to 94.04
item.description:
Signal: a weaker rupee. 17 reports from The Shillong Times, The Hindu, Investment Guru India and 11 more. Related: “Rupee hits one-week low, slips past 94 per dollar”. Mixed: 16 reports point the other way. Ongoing: also reported on 1 of the previous 7 days (first 12 Nov).

IT services: strong tailwind (+3) — IT exporters earn more in rupees

Why it matters: A weaker rupee raises the cost of oil and other imports and imported inflation, but lifts IT and pharma exporters' rupee earnings.

Market gauges: Rupee −3, Inflation outlook −1, Foreign investor flows −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks

item.title: [+1] US Dollar Index (DXY) sits near April 2025 highs, above 10.300 on Fed bets and Iran risks
item.description:

IT services: mild tailwind (+1) — Dollar earnings worth more
